description: Sign in with a wallet and create an API key in one call; the full tool set is then unlocked in this session (no restart needed). Either pass address + signature of a challenge from dominusnode_wallet_challenge, or omit the signature when DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE is configured: the server then requests the challenge and signs it with that key (it only signs the standard sign-in message).

address.description: Your Ethereum wallet address (0x...). Optional with DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE.

signature.description: The EIP-191 signature of the challenge message. Omit to sign with DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE.

name: dominusnode_wallet_setup
